page_title: ALA 1-1 ATM | Alaves v Atletico Madrid 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+16' The match has just finished.
90+14' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Antonio Sivera intercepts the ball.
90+12' Atl. Madrid hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
90+8' The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
90+7' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
90+6' A player from Alaves takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' Koke (Atl. Madrid) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Victor Garcia ignores the protests.
90+4' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90+3' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
90+2' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90' 15 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Atl. Madrid showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Denis Suarez (Alaves) is coming onto the pitch as Carlos Protesoni cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid) replaces Julian Alvarez.
88' It is time for a substitution. Koke (Atl. Madrid) is on for Giuliano Simeone.
87' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
87' One of the Alaves players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
85' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop.
84' Victor Parada (Alaves) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Victor Garcia didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

83' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Jan Oblak, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
81' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
80' Substitution. Mariano Diaz (Alaves) in, Toni Martinez out.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Ibanez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Carlos Protesoni (Alaves).
79' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
77' Atl. Madrid win a corner.
77' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Good work from Atl. Madrid as they win a corner.
76' The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.

76' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Antonio Sivera shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
74' Poor challenge! Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for tripping and Victor Garcia blows his whistle.
73' The attendance for today's match is 18042.
73' Here is a change. Thiago Almada is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
72' It's time for a substitution. Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) comes on in place of David Hancko.
72' It will be a substitution. Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Johnny Cardoso walks off.
71' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
70' We are about to witness a corner kick, another promising situation.
70' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
69' The Atl. Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
65' The game is interrupted.
59' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
58' Problems for Eduardo Coudet as Moussa Diarra (Alaves) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ander Guevara replaces him.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Victor Parada (Alaves) will replace Jon Guridi.
56' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Victor Garcia stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
55' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
54' The game is interrupted now, Moussa Diarra (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
54' Atl. Madrid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
51' Alaves are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
49' Toni Martinez (Alaves) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
47' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' A player from Atl. Madrid pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
42' Victor Garcia shows the yellow card to Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) for a heavy challenge.
41' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atl. Madrid.
39' Atl. Madrid are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
38' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Moussa Diarra (Alaves).
37' Neat passing move from Atl. Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.

34' Atl. Madrid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
33' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
32' Alaves are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
31' The Alaves players find the open spaces by moving the ball around, but the move ends with an involuntarily pass to the opposition.
29' The foul by Johnny Cardoso (Atl. Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Victor Garcia.
27' The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.
27' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
23' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
21' Victor Garcia has a clear sight and sees a foul from Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
20' Close! David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
18' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
17' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
14' 1 - 1 Goal! Carlos Vicente (Alaves) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jan Oblak into right side of the goal.
14' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

14' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) jumps into a tackle and Victor Garcia signals a foul. PENALTY to Alaves! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
12' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Alaves.

12' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
11' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
10' Alaves show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
6' Jon Guridi (Alaves) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
5' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Alaves.
4' The Alaves players are exchanging some short passes.
3' A pass into the penalty area from Moussa Diarra (Alaves) is intercepted by the defence.
1' The first half has just begun.
Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Victor Garcia.
